# Elixpo Accounts

Elixpo Accounts is the OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect identity provider for Elixpo and third-party applications. It runs on Cloudflare Pages and exposes an edge-safe TypeScript SDK as `@elixpo/accounts`.

## Canonical documentation

- [Developer documentation](https://accounts.elixpo.com/docs)
- [OAuth flow](https://accounts.elixpo.com/docs/oauth)
- [Quickstart](https://accounts.elixpo.com/docs/quickstart)
- [Users API](https://accounts.elixpo.com/docs/users-api)
- [Webhooks](https://accounts.elixpo.com/docs/webhooks)
- [Errors](https://accounts.elixpo.com/docs/errors)
- [OAuth discovery](https://accounts.elixpo.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- [OpenID discovery](https://accounts.elixpo.com/.well-known/openid-configuration)
- [JWKS](https://accounts.elixpo.com/.well-known/jwks.json)

## Integration rules

- Use authorization code flow with S256 PKCE, state, and nonce.
- Keep client secrets, refresh tokens, and authorization transactions server-side.
- Rotate refresh tokens atomically and verify ID/access tokens against JWKS.
- Use hosted Accounts pages for credentials, MFA, consent, and account selection.
